pages.text: A powerful and ferocious beast, born in rage, trampling everything before it with unbelievable brute force. Though the Mutant Hoglin appears formidable, you can forcibly bind its wild nature through a ritual, thus ensuring that the resulting Mutant Hoglin remains loyal to you.
Just like the Hoglin Servant, you can ride this massive beast and control its movement in a similar manner. You can even command it to charge, crushing everything in its path.
Sneak + right-click your Mutant Hoglin Servant with Crimson Fungus to heal them. If their owner wears Nether Robes, they can also heal themselves using their owner's Soul Energy.
